function: Over-the-air (analog) model aggregation for wireless federated learning with online trust and transmit power control (TO-OAC, TOR-OAC), single-antenna UEs and BS over orthogonal subchannels (p. 4).
notes: Exclude, system (p. 4). It is an area 7 work: analog over-the-air aggregation of FL models (passes no_learning, above_phy, and function), but the link has one antenna at each UE and at the BS and no RIS. p. 4: "Each component of the transmission signal vector is transmitted across orthogonal channels that are segregated by frequency or time" and "htu = [htu,1 , . . . , htu,d ]T ∈ C d serves as the channel state vector for the connection between UE u and BS"; p. 5: ctu is "the entry-wise channel inversion vector". Table II (p. 14, read from the PDF image) gives "Subchannel S 500" and "Bandwidth Bw 15 kHz" and no number of antennas. MIMO appears only as future work, p. 3: "In future, we can consider ... massive MIMO [44], and near-field MIMO [45]". No RIS, OTFS, or NTN link. Title and DOI on p. 1 match the record.
